title: Introduce probing-sherpa orchestration and priority-delay smoother CI hook
author: Aisha Patel
body:
Motivation: CI has become noisy for prompt-set regression checks as the probing fanout increases. Small transient failures (latency spikes, timeout-limited probes) are causing undue alert churn and blocking rollouts. This change introduces a lightweight orchestration layer (probing-sherpa) that prioritizes probe execution across cohorts, applies a configurable priority-delay smoother to reduce thrash on CI gates, and introduces an auto-tiered softfail path so non-critical probes can be deferred rather than failing the entire CI run.

Design summary: probing-sherpa is an execution arbiter implemented as a pluggable eval-harness hook. It consumes probe descriptors and assigns execution priority based on cohort importance, historical flakiness, and freshness. The priority-delay smoother introduces an exponential backoff window before low-priority probes escalate to hard-fail, with tunable thresholds per-linear-ticket. An auto-tiered softfail policy classifies probes into critical / advisory / exploratory tiers; advisory/exploratory failures surface in reports and trigger retry/backfill flows but do not block merges by default.

What this PR does (high level): - Adds new orchestration module eval_harness/hooks/probing_sherpa.py - Implements CI adapter ci/hooks/priority_delay_smoother.py to integrate with GitHub Actions and our internal runner - Adds an in-process probe classifier and tier mapper in eval_harness/triage/tier_map.py - Adds a compact JSON reporter that summarizes tiered outcomes and suggested follow-ups - Adds e2e smoke and deterministic unit tests to reduce regressions - Adds docs and a runbook describing operational knobs and rollback steps

Migration and rollout: feature is behind an opt-in gate controlled by a new eval config flag `probing_sherpa.enabled`. We'll start with advisory-only mode for two weeks on the main branch, then enable tiered softfail for non-release branches. The runbook lists Linear tasks for tuning thresholds and monitoring key metrics (probe latency distribution, softfail ratio).

Checklist: - [x] Unit tests covering priority decisions and smoothing behavior - [x] E2E smoke tests for CI hook integration - [x] Documentation: runbook + README - [x] Backwards compatible: defaults off and non-blocking for existing workflows - [x] Linear ticket created for production tuning and post-rollout audit

Testing notes: 1) Unit tests run locally and on CI (deterministic seeding added for triage logic). 2) Integration tests required a small mock of the internal runner; added ci/test_mocks/runner_stub.py. 3) Verified CI gate behavior in a canary repo where advisory failures were surfaced but did not block merge.

Risks & mitigation: The main risk is undercounting critical probes as advisory. Mitigation: default mapping is conservative (most existing CI probes remain critical), we added an explicit review step in the rollout plan to audit tier assignments, and the config allows per-prompt overrides.

Related work/refs: Linear ENG-2345 (probe orchestration), ENG-2407 (ci stability initiative). See docs/eval/runbooks/probing_sherpa.md for playbook and tuning knobs.
commits: feat(probing): add probing_sherpa orchestration layer and priority decision API
feat(ci): priority_delay_smoother GitHub Actions hook + runner adapter
refactor(triage): introduce tier_map and deterministic seeding for classifiers
test: add unit tests for priority/backoff and e2e smoke test for CI hook
docs: runbook and README for probing_sherpa rollout
review_comments: Morgan Lee: Nice separation of concerns. Two asks: (1) make the default smoothing window configurable via env var for faster canary tuning, (2) add one more unit test for the case where priority scores tie — please add deterministic tiebreaker in docs.

Author (Aisha Patel): Addressed both points; smoothing window is now env-configurable (see ci/hooks/priority_delay_smoother.py) and added deterministic tiebreaker in tier_map. Added test case in tests/unit/test_sherpa_priority.py (commit 3).

Priya Khanna: Can we keep a compact perf metric emitted per-run? I want a 95th percentile probe latency so we can detect when smoothing masks underlying slow probes. Suggested adding metric `sherpa.probe_latency_p95`.
Author (Aisha Patel): Added metric emission to the JSON reporter and integrated with existing metrics sink. See reporter changes and updated docs with the metric name and alert guidance.
Ethan Ross: Integration tests flaked once on the runner stub timeout; re-run CI after increasing stub timeouts — LGTM after green.
CI bot: integration-tests re-run: all checks passed.
merge_details: Merged by Morgan Lee using squash merge. Commit message condensed into: 'feat(eval): probing-sherpa orchestration + CI priority-delay smoother; tests and docs'. Canary rollout enabled in advisory mode. Backport not required.
release_notes: Add a new opt-in eval-harness orchestration 'probing-sherpa' to prioritize and smooth probe execution; introduces a priority-delay CI hook and tiered softfail policy to reduce noisy CI failures. Default disabled. See docs/eval/runbooks/probing_sherpa.md for rollout and tuning.
